```{python}
df = Fabricator().make(10, 'fivd')
```


```{python}
GT(df, date_format='%y-%m-%d')
```


```{python}
GT(df, date_format='%H:%M:%S')
```


```{python}
GT(df, float_format='.5g')
```

THIS IS THE HARDER PART!
```{python}
GT(df, formatters={'all': lambda x: f'{x:,.5f}'})
```
